description: Ethics decomposed. Trolley variants (footbridge, transplant), doing vs allowing, doctrine of double effect, demandingness objection, Rawlsian justice, capabilities approach, animal ethics, environmental ethics, applied ethics (medical, AI).

sub_mechanisms.name: trolley_variants
sub_mechanisms.definition: Standard: switch tracks, 1 dies vs 5. Footbridge: push fat man, 1 dies vs 5. Different intuitions.
sub_mechanisms.why: Tests theories. Switch (mostly accept); push (mostly reject). Doctrine of double effect explains: side effect vs means.

sub_mechanisms.name: doctrine_double_effect
sub_mechanisms.definition: OK to cause bad effect as side-effect of good act; not OK if bad effect is means.
sub_mechanisms.why: Thomas Aquinas. Distinguishes trolley variants. Applied: pain medication hastening death (OK if pain relief intent).

sub_mechanisms.name: doing_vs_allowing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Morally weightier to do harm than to allow it. Foot.
sub_mechanisms.why: Distinguishes killing from letting die. Applied: euthanasia, charity. Critics: arbitrary.

sub_mechanisms.name: demandingness_objection
sub_mechanisms.definition: Consequentialism demands too much: maximise good means constantly sacrificing.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard critique of utilitarianism. Williams' attack on impartiality. Replies: agent-relative perms, satisficing.

sub_mechanisms.name: Rawls_veil_ignorance
sub_mechanisms.definition: Principles of justice = those chosen behind veil of ignorance about one's position.
sub_mechanisms.why: Rawls 1971 'A Theory of Justice'. Modern liberalism foundation. Maximin: maximise worst-off position. Critics: many.

sub_mechanisms.name: capabilities_approach
sub_mechanisms.definition: Sen + Nussbaum. Justice as developed capabilities (not just resources or utility).
sub_mechanisms.why: Alternative to utility + resources. UN Human Development Index. Foundation development ethics.

sub_mechanisms.name: animal_ethics_speciesism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Singer: speciesism analogous to racism. Equal consideration for capacity to suffer.
sub_mechanisms.why: Foundation of modern animal ethics. Utilitarian basis. Drives factory farming, animal research debates.

sub_mechanisms.name: environmental_ethics
sub_mechanisms.definition: Moral status of non-humans + ecosystems. Anthropocentric vs biocentric vs ecocentric.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern field. Climate ethics central. Future generations. Foundation of environmental policy.

sub_mechanisms.name: medical_ethics_principlism
sub_mechanisms.definition: Beauchamp + Childress: autonomy, beneficence, non-maleficence, justice. Four principles.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard medical ethics framework. Applied clinical decision-making. Foundation of bioethics.

sub_mechanisms.name: AI_ethics_specific
sub_mechanisms.definition: Bias, transparency, accountability, autonomy preservation, value alignment.
sub_mechanisms.why: Emerging field. Algorithm fairness, X-risk, work displacement. Foundation of modern technology ethics.

sub_mechanisms.name: experimental_philosophy_ethics
sub_mechanisms.definition: Empirical study of moral intuitions. Different demographics + cultures.
sub_mechanisms.why: Knobe + others. Trolley variants surveyed cross-culturally. Influence on metaethics. Calling armchair into question.

sub_mechanisms.name: moral_uncertainty
sub_mechanisms.definition: How to act when uncertain about ethics? MacAskill + Ord.
sub_mechanisms.why: Modern formal approach. Maximise expected moral value across theories. Foundation of effective altruism.

derivation_rules.name: trolley_variants_distinguish_theories
if: intuitive responses to trolley variants differ
then: acceptable ethical theory must explain the difference
derivation_rules.why: Standard methodology. Theories that say 'consequentialism: switch + push both OK' don't match intuitions. Doctrine of double effect explains.

derivation_rules.name: DDE_distinguishes_means_from_side_effects
if: bad effect is side effect of good act
derivation_rules.why: Trolley switch: death side effect of saving 5. Push: death means to saving 5. DDE: first OK, second not. Aquinas. Foundation Catholic ethics.

derivation_rules.name: Rawls_maximin_demands_concern_for_worst_off
if: behind veil of ignorance, choose principles
derivation_rules.why: Risk aversion (you might be worst-off). Yields liberal egalitarianism. Critics: not all behind-veil choices yield this. Foundation.

derivation_rules.name: capabilities_address_resource_focus_failure
derivation_rules.why: Disabled person + same money + less actual capability. Capabilities approach captures this. Foundation human development.

derivation_rules.name: moral_uncertainty_requires_meta_framework
derivation_rules.why: MacAskill: weight by credence in theory. Foundation effective altruism. Modern formal ethics. Cost: intertheoretic comparisons.
